ephesians.5.p1.b1.text: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,

ephesians.5.p1.b2.text: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.

ephesians.5.p1.b3.text: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.

ephesians.5.p2.b1.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, … Therefore do not be partakers with them.

ephesians.5.p2.b2.text: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

ephesians.5.p2.b3.text: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.

ephesians.5.p3.b1.text: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

ephesians.5.p3.b2.text: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.

ephesians.5.p3.b3.text: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

ephesians.5.p4.b1.text: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, … redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

ephesians.5.p4.b2.text: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,

ephesians.5.p4.b3.text: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

ephesians.5.p5.b1.text: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

ephesians.5.p5.b2.text: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, …

ephesians.5.p5.b3.text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her

ephesians.5.p6.b1.text: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word, and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, …

ephesians.5.p6.b2.text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

ephesians.5.p6.b3.text: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.

ephesians.5.p6.b4.text: For we are members of His body.

ephesians.5.p7.b1.text: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”

ephesians.5.p7.b2.text: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.

ephesians.5.p7.b3.text: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
